faqs.qEn: How many capsules are in 1 bottle of Grow XL and how long does a bottle last?
faqs.aEn: Each authentic bottle of Grow XL (SKU: ONYX-GX-30, MPN: GXL-30CAP-MY) contains 30 capsules. At the recommended daily dosage of 1 capsule per day, 1 bottle provides a complete 30-day (1 full month) supply.
faqs.qMs: Berapakah bilangan kapsul di dalam 1 botol Grow XL dan berapa lama ia bertahan?
faqs.aMs: Setiap botol tulen Grow XL (SKU: ONYX-GX-30, MPN: GXL-30CAP-MY) mengandungi 30 kapsul. Pada sukatan yang disyorkan iaitu 1 kapsul sehari, 1 botol mencukupi untuk bekalan penuh selama 30 hari (1 bulan).

faqs.qEn: How does Grow XL (30 Capsules) compare to Horsemen and Hammer of Thor (20 Capsules)?
faqs.aEn: Grow XL is designed as a 30-day daily nutritional conditioning protocol (1 capsule every morning/evening for 30 days) featuring Muira Puama, Saw Palmetto, Tongkat Ali, Maca, and L-Arginine. Horsemen and Hammer of Thor are more concentrated 20-capsule cycles geared toward evening stamina or Tribulus saponin conditioning.
faqs.qMs: Apakah perbezaan antara Grow XL (30 Kapsul) berbanding Horsemen dan Hammer of Thor (20 Kapsul)?
faqs.aMs: Grow XL direka sebagai protokol penjagaan harian selama 30 hari penuh (1 kapsul sehari) yang menggabungkan Muira Puama, Saw Palmetto, Tongkat Ali, Maca, dan L-Arginine. Horsemen dan Hammer of Thor pula ialah kitaran 20 kapsul berkepekatan tinggi untuk kesediaan malam atau fokus saponin Tribulus.

faqs.qEn: How does Grow XL differ from Magnum Pump XR (both 30-capsule bottles)?
faqs.aEn: While both contain 30 capsules at RM 159, Grow XL is an all-day natural botanical performance blend (Tongkat Ali, Maca, Muira Puama, Saw Palmetto) taken once daily after breakfast. Magnum Pump XR (30 Black Capsules) is a specialized Nitric Oxide & Testosterone Pro Series formula dominated by L-Arginine HCl, L-Citrulline, Black Ginger, and Bioperine taken 30–45 minutes before gym workouts or evening activity.
faqs.qMs: Apakah perbezaan antara Grow XL dan Magnum Pump XR memandangkan kedua-duanya mempunyai 30 kapsul?
faqs.aMs: Walaupun kedua-duanya mengandungi 30 kapsul pada harga RM 159, Grow XL ialah campuran herba semula jadi harian (Tongkat Ali, Maca, Muira Puama, Saw Palmetto) yang diambil selepas sarapan. Magnum Pump XR (30 Kapsul Hitam) pula ialah formulasi khusus Nitrik Oksida (L-Arginine HCl, L-Citrulline, Kunyit Hitam, Bioperine) yang diambil 30–45 minit sebelum senaman atau aktiviti malam.

faqs.qEn: Why is the refill reminder for Grow XL set to Day 25 instead of Day 18?
faqs.aEn: Because Grow XL contains 30 capsules per bottle (compared to 20 capsules in Horsemen and Hammer of Thor), Day 25 is when you have 5 capsules remaining—giving ample time for our 1–2 day discreet courier delivery to reach you before Day 30.
